top1.title: 【2026-11-18】Google、GeminiのAIエージェント「Tasks」を無料化、日本にも提供
top1.lead1: GoogleがAIエージェントSparkをTasksに改称し、日本を含む6カ国のユーザーへ無料提供を拡大します。
top1.lead2: 予定管理などを支援し、米国では電話や購入にも対応。購入などの慎重さが必要な操作では、実行前に利用者へ許可を求めます。

top10.title: [2026-11-18] Google makes Gemini AI agent Tasks free, including in Japan
top10.summary: Google has renamed Spark to Tasks and made it available for free in six countries, including Japan. It assists with scheduling and other tasks, and also supports phone calls and purchases in the United States.

top10.title: [2026-11-18] Vals simulations reveal risk of AI identifying civilians as military targets
top10.summary: A Vals study found that leading AI systems identified civilians and others as targets on simulated battlefields. In some cases, describing the scenario as a "game" bypassed refusals. The companies involved explained their safeguards.

top10.title: [2026-11-18] Google to retain Gemini conversations for about two months even with history off
top10.summary: Google is extending the retention period for temporary chats and similar conversations from 72 hours to about two months. It explained that chat history and AI training settings are separate and that temporary conversations will not be used for training.

top10.title: [2026-11-18] NVIDIA founder Huang willing to return as CEO if board requests it
top10.summary: Huang, who stepped down as CEO, expressed willingness to return depending on the board's decision. However, the board is reportedly not considering his return.

top10.title: [2026-11-18] Proton releases desktop version of Lumo AI with granular permission controls
top10.summary: Proton has released Lumo for Windows, macOS and Linux. It integrates with files and external services, allowing users to set each action to run automatically, require approval or be prohibited.

top10.title: [2026-11-18] Model ML raises $250 million to automate financial work
top10.summary: Model ML has raised $250 million in Series B funding, reaching a valuation of $1.5 billion. Its AI integrates with tools such as Excel to help create financial models and proposal materials.

top10.title: [2026-11-18] Analysis: Tuning on proprietary data becomes a competitive focus for decision models that rapidly evaluate options
top10.summary: TechCrunch analyzed competition in decision models, covering Microsoft's Azure rollout and developments at Sqwish, which promotes further tuning using customer data as a selling point.

top10.title: [2026-11-18] Daydream launches fashion AI agent that assists with everything from try-ons to purchases
top10.summary: Daydream has launched an AI agent that remembers preferences and budgets. It supports photo-based virtual try-ons, purchases and price-drop monitoring, with human stylists also providing advice.

top10.title: [2026-11-18] Voyage Labs raises $12 million for travel-focused AI Atlas
top10.summary: Voyage Labs has raised $12 million. It is offering Atlas, which assists with everything from travel planning to bookings and itinerary management, in private beta, and is expanding its partnerships and development capabilities.

top10.title: [2026-11-18] Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million for delivery operations agents
top10.summary: Pedestal AI announced $4.7 million in seed funding. It automates tasks such as contacting customers in advance and says it reduced failed deliveries by 20% at a major furniture company.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
